text:
linus: Quick follow-up to the onprem packaging RFC — proposal to shift to delegated signing + agent backoff handshake. Link to RFC: https://rfc.internal/packaging/delegated-signing

maya: TL;DR? what's delegated signing mean for ops?

linus: Instead of central key signing every delta, operator can delegate short-lived signing tokens to an admin-operator CA. Agents verify chain-of-trust + per-delta nonce. Main win: smaller offline payloads, less operator churn.

oliver: How do we prevent rogue operator minting deltas? sounds risky.

linus: Two mitigations:
1) Obligate time-bound tokens (TTL 1hr) + KMS rotation
2) Require quorum signatures for release nodes (>=2 sigs)

srini: Quorum across onprem? offline clusters may only have single admin.

linus: Good point — fallback: allow single-sig in airgapped with extra operator ack in console and stricter activation windows.

maya: UX concern: ops will be confused by extra acks. Can we fold it into the existing "activate bundle" flow?

linus: Yes — proposal: agent prompts operator with exact hashes and operator approves via local CLI token: `rwdctl activate --hash <sha256>`

deploy-bot: Deploy started for artifact 2026-03-03T12:01Z :rocket:

oliver: What about rollback safety? If a bad delta activated, how do we revoke delegated tokens?

linus: Tokens are short-lived; but we also include activation checkpoints in manifest with revocation-listing. Agent keeps last-known-good manifest and can refuse auto-apply if mismatch.

srini: Can agents fetch revocation list when offline? no.

linus: Right — we propose sticky revocation anchored in the seed (pre-bundled) and a "fail-closed" policy for critical manifests.

eva: Operationally, we need a small tool to generate delegated tokens and a signing preview for admin. Who owns that?

maya: Security + ops should own the token-tool. Maybe small go binary `rwd-delegate`.

linus: Implementation sketch in RFC appendix: bundle header example:
```
bundle.v2 {
  manifest: {...},
  delegates: [ { id: "ops-1", token_ttl: 3600, sig: "..." } ],
  activation_window: { start: 168..., duration: 3600 }
}
```

oliver: Perf: will agents need more CPU to verify chains? can be expensive for many small deltas.

linus: Verification is cheap (ECDSA/Ed25519). We can cache verified public keys per-seed and reuse per-batch.

srini: Backoff behavior: agent should try exponential with jitter when contacting distributor. Also local apply queue for staged patches.

maya: propose default backoff: 1s, 4s, 16s, 1m, then operator alert. Documentable knob.

linus: OK — next steps: I'll update RFC with token-tool prototype + activation UX mock. Any objections to delegated signing + agent backoff as default for airgapped tier?

eva: No objections, want to see a demo.

oliver: fine but highlight single-sig risk in bold in RFC.

maya: +1

srini: +1

linus: will send updated RFC by EOD and add a small integration test harness for offline apply. Thanks.
